items.title: Dick Spottswood interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 13, 2023
items.q: they take a black person, who was the actual supervisor of recording, Mayo Williams, very famous in the recording industry when it comes to documenting black music on records for over a quarter century.

ctx.x: It’s — I just think it’s interesting that people come to folks like yourself looking for specific answers but you recognize that specific answers are problematic. Is that a fair statement? © Fillius Jazz Archive -14-

Well it’s a problematic statement because that’s true in some instances but in other instances if you’re referring to matters of fact — did this or did this not occur, and did it occur in the way that it is said to have occurred. I guess one famous instance being back to my main topic here did the movie “Ma Rainey’s Black Bottom” that whole story is fictionalized and it is fictionalized in a way that almost eliminates Ma Rainey as the center of attention in the original play and of course in the movie. And the…
I feel like I’ve been duped.
